reuse.why: All providers share the new link guards, and Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, although local unlink state is copied.

duplication.why: Fintegra repeats the existing account-link workflow and transaction-download plumbing, while replacement duplicates unlinkAccount's local cleanup.

placement.why: Link policy, request orchestration, transaction downloads, server configuration and provider types follow the tree's existing module boundaries.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the four requested linking changes and server-side Fintegra support.

maintainability.why: Shared guards keep provider policy consistent, but a validation-named helper now mutates accounts and duplicated workflows increase future maintenance.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers use the shared guards and bank lookup; existing unlinkAccount also performs remote cleanup, so it is not directly reusable for takeover.

disguised_duplication.where: app.ts linkFintegraAccount condenses the existing provider-link workflow, and sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes downloadEnableBankingTransactions with a different endpoint and omitted aspspName.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a replacement branch that changes the shared guard into a mutating operation; all six providers continue calling it.
